name: agent-activity
description: The agent's live activity as rows the desktop renders in the room (events drawer) and the dock (Agent activity panel). Hooks produce the Working and Thinking rows; nothing depends on the agent remembering. Config: AGENT_DISPLAY_NAME names the agent in the first row (env override > this manifest > 'Your agent'). PHASE_MODEL (off|vertex, default off) refines the phase word and writes a status line with Gemini on PHASE_MODEL_PROJECT; the only network use, and only when on (scripts/phase_line.py).
